title: MAEM: Mitigating Recency Bias via a Replay-Free, Capacity-Controlled Dynamic Mixture of Experts for Class-Incremental Graph Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.20238v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) excel on graph-structured data but suffer catastrophic forgetting when classes arrive sequentially. In class-incremental graph learning, predictions are often dominated by recently learned classes, causing severe recency bias. Dynamic expansion can isolate knowledge across sessions, but many methods assume task-incremental settings and require task identities at test time to select branches or heads---information unavailable in class-incremental learning. Learnable routers offer an alternative, yet continual fine-tuning the router on new data can bias routing toward recent components. We propose MAEM, a replay-free, capacity-controlled dynamic mixture-of-experts framework for class-incremental graph learning. MAEM builds representations with Simplified Graph Convolution (SGC) and trains a dedicated expert for each new session, then freezes it to protect prior knowledge. For routing without task IDs or a share

translated_title: MAEM：通过无重放、容量控制的动态专家混合来缓解类增量图学习中的近期偏差
translated_abstract: 图神经网络在图结构数据上表现出色，但当类别按顺序依次到达时会遭受灾难性遗忘。在类增量图学习中，预测结果往往由最近学习的类别主导，从而产生严重的近期偏差。动态扩展方法可以将知识在不同会话间隔离，但许多方法假设的是任务增量设置，在测试时需要任务标识来选择分支或输出头——而这一信息在类增量学习中是无法获得的。可学习的路由器提供了一种替代方案，但在新数据上持续微调路由器可能使路由偏向最近添加的组件。我们提出了MAEM，一个面向类增量图学习的无重放、容量控制的动态专家混合框架。MAEM使用简化图卷积（SGC）构建节点表示，并为每个新会话训练一个专用专家，随后将其冻结以保护已有知识。对于无需任务ID的路由机制……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出MAEM框架，通过为每个新会话训练并冻结专用专家、以无重放且容量受控的动态专家混合方式进行路由，从而在无需任务标识的情况下缓解类增量图学习中的近期偏差与灾难性遗忘。
